card.name: Materials-science text before 'materials' words
card.fires_on: Words in materials-science and biomimetic writing where the next word is likely 'materials' or 'material', such as 'structural', 'layer-by-layer', 'metals such', 'materials with'. It responds to linking words and adjectives, not to the noun itself.
